kjv: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

lines.say: Worn out tonight? Hear this before bed.
My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever. Psalm seventy three, verse twenty six.
lines.big: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

lines.say: When your body and your heart both give out, he's still holding.
lines.big: When your body and your heart both give out, he's still holding.

lines.say: Lord, be the strength of my heart tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.
